method:
Record enemy alternatives from actual mGBA AI and ordinary combat.

The seed, room transition, safe player position/facing, inventory/healing and
removal of unrelated actors are disclosed fixtures. Boss HP fixtures select
the existing phase thresholds; they never assign an AI state/timer, body pose,
animation phase or height. Every enemy comes from the real generated room.
Source atlases separately establish complete authored-frame coverage.

context.clear_lane_rule: Every covered metatile is TT_FLOOR, non-prop, collision0 and overlayNONE; no bridge, water, ledge, canopy or raised decoration.

captures.note: Supplementary natural pursuer on an independently selected unobstructed natural floor lane. No enemy position/state/timer/frame or terrain writes. Main bridge-depth recordings remain untouched.

archival_formats.all_frames_note: Local archival source only; not an active publication path.

presentation_note: Read-only gEnemyPresentedFrame reports draw-selected pose; queued hardware uploads can lag one VBlank. Hardware OAM presence is captured separately. Source-only directions/compatibility poses are not claimed as observed runtime frames.

publication.method: Active media are unchanged copies of approved frozen-ROM mGBA output. Local raw all-frame directories and inexact GIFs are archival only.
